label: HABIT 1
head: Hitting snooze until 10am
sub: Marcus Aurelius: you were made to get up and work, not lie under blankets.

label: HABIT 2
head: Stressing over what you can't control
sub: Epictetus: some things are up to you, most aren't. Only touch the first list.

label: HABIT 3
head: Saying yes to everyone
sub: Seneca: men guard their money but hand out their time for free.

label: HABIT 4
head: Hanging with the wrong crowd
sub: Meditations opens by thanking the people who made Marcus better.

label: HABIT 5
head: Acting like you'll live forever
sub: Seneca: life isn't short. We waste most of it.

text: Life is long *if you know* how to use it.
